---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What is missing or hard to do today?

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## New language request

If you are requesting support for a new language, please also provide:

- Locale code: <e.g. fr, de, nl; use the same style as existing locales such as es, en_GB, ast>
- Authoritative grammar reference: a link or citation to a reliable source describing how cardinal numbers are formed in that language (official academy, standard grammar, or widely accepted reference). This is used to verify the output empirically.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate the request.
